scope: Independent flat Unity environment preview; no source model changes and no replacement of the formal playable map.

direction.walkable_ground: One level inland surface; sea and closed pond basins only, no continuous playable hills or isolated building pads.
direction.composition: Grouped settlement and ore clusters, coherent ground-cover patches, clear open operating areas.
direction.roads: Road slot retained with zero weight; no paths, ruts, paving or rivers.
direction.render_pipeline: Existing Built-in pipeline retained. No implicit URP/HDRP migration.

missing_assets.status: Not supplied by current accepted vegetation source; tree count remains zero in this preview instead of forcing the sparse-crown source.
